tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Window background and the Perform key deck. Spec: color.bg.app.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Panels: the Perform main area, sidebar, editor tabs. Spec: color.bg.surface.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: The current setlist row and plan tile, menus, popovers, dialogs. Spec: color.bg.raised.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Wells: the key and tempo windows, segmented-control tracks, text fields, meters. Spec: color.bg.inset.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Rules between panels, rows and tiles. Decorative in dark and light; 3:1 in contrast. Spec: color.border.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Faint rules inside a list or table. Spec: color.divider.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline that identifies a text field, select, checkbox or toggle track; 3:1 on bg-surface and bg-inset in every theme.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Key (button) face at rest. Dark: REC charcoal.

tokens.name: key-hover
tokens.usage: Key face under the pointer.

tokens.name: key-pressed
tokens.usage: Key face while pressed or held.

tokens.name: key-edge
tokens.usage: Key outline and the 1 px lower edge that makes it read as raised.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Main text and key labels, on every bg-* token and on key. Spec: color.text.primary.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary lines, hints, MD notes, on every bg-*, key and state-pending-subtle. Spec: color.text.secondary.

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase group labels (TRANSPORT, NOW, SONG BAR), on bg-app, bg-surface, bg-raised and bg-inset. Not on key: use text-key-hint.

tokens.name: text-key-hint
tokens.usage: Shortcut letter printed on a key (V, R, G, Esc), on key.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Played and skipped plan items, past setlist rows, on bg-surface and bg-app.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels. Exempt from contrast; always paired with a flat, edgeless key. Spec: color.text.disabled.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill (Play/GO). Spec: color.text.onAccent.

tokens.name: text-on-section
tokens.usage: Letter on a section-* fill; 6:1 or better on every section colour.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: REC yellow. Fill of the one primary key (Play/GO), the current-position marker, the lit LED. Never a large area. Spec: color.accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Yellow key under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Outline and lower edge of the yellow key.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent-text, used rarely (an armed tile). Spec: color.accent.subtle.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Yellow as text or a thin mark (NOW tag, armed outline), on bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-app. In light it darkens to ochre.

tokens.name: state-playing
tokens.usage: PLAYING pill, OK indicator dots. As text on bg-surface, bg-raised, bg-app. Spec: color.state.playing.

tokens.name: state-ready
tokens.usage: READY pill. Spec: color.state.ready.

tokens.name: state-hold
tokens.usage: HOLD pill and the hold tile; always with the pause icon and PRESS GO. Spec: color.state.hold.

tokens.name: state-pending
tokens.usage: A queued jump: NEXT tag, countdown, dashed target outline, CANCEL LED; on bg-surface, bg-raised and state-pending-subtle. Spec: color.state.pending.

tokens.name: state-pending-subtle
tokens.usage: NEXT card ground while an action is pending.

tokens.name: state-pending-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of the pending progress bar.

tokens.name: state-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings: rendering, service check warnings, large key shifts. Always with the warning icon or a word. Spec: color.state.warning.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Errors, PANIC label, device lost, missing files; on bg-* and key. Spec: color.state.error.

tokens.name: state-success
tokens.usage: Done states (Ready check, render complete). Spec: color.state.success.

tokens.name: state-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Banner ground for warnings; text-primary and text-secondary on it.

tokens.name: state-error-subtle
tokens.usage: Banner ground for errors and the assistant error row.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a dialog.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: An unlit LED on a key or indicator; the lit state also changes the key's label.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px solid keyboard-focus outline, 2 px offset; 3:1 or better on every bg-* and key.

tokens.name: section-intro
tokens.usage: Intro. Letter I. Spec: color.section.intro.

tokens.name: section-verse
tokens.usage: Verse. Letter V + number (V1). Spec: color.section.verse.

tokens.name: section-pre-chorus
tokens.usage: Pre-chorus. Letters PC. Spec: color.section.preChorus.

tokens.name: section-chorus
tokens.usage: Chorus. Letter C + occurrence (C1). Spec: color.section.chorus.

tokens.name: section-post-chorus
tokens.usage: Post-chorus. Letters PoC. Spec: color.section.postChorus.

tokens.name: section-bridge
tokens.usage: Bridge. Letter B. Spec: color.section.bridge.

tokens.name: section-interlude
tokens.usage: Interlude, instrumental, turnaround. Letters IL / IN / TU. Spec: color.section.interlude.

tokens.name: section-vamp
tokens.usage: Vamp, breakdown, build. Letters VA / BR / BU. Spec: color.section.vamp.

tokens.name: section-tag
tokens.usage: Tag. Letter T. Spec: color.section.tag.

tokens.name: section-outro
tokens.usage: Outro. Letter O. Spec: color.section.outro.

tokens.name: section-ending
tokens.usage: Ending. Letter E. Spec: color.section.ending.

tokens.name: section-other
tokens.usage: Other or untyped. Diamond icon. Spec: color.section.other.

tokens.name: section-click
tokens.usage: Click bars. Metronome icon. Spec: color.section.click.

tokens.name: section-pad
tokens.usage: Pad bars. Wave icon. Spec: color.section.pad.

tokens.name: section-hold
tokens.usage: Hold entries. Pause icon. Spec: color.section.hold.

tokens.name: waveform
tokens.usage: Track waveforms in the timeline. Spec: color.waveform.

tokens.name: waveform-muted
tokens.usage: Regions muted by the arrangement; the strip also shows the A badge. Spec: color.waveform.muted.

tokens.name: meter-low
tokens.usage: Meter segments below −18 dBFS. Spec: color.meter.low.

tokens.name: meter-mid
tokens.usage: Meter segments −18 to −6 dBFS. Spec: color.meter.mid.

tokens.name: meter-high
tokens.usage: Meter segments above −6 dBFS and the clip light. Spec: color.meter.high.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line in the timeline and mini timeline. Spec: color.playhead.

tokens.name: loop
tokens.usage: Rehearsal loop region fill; edges use loop-edge. Spec: color.loop.

tokens.name: loop-edge
tokens.usage: Loop region start and end lines.

tokens.name: pending-marker
tokens.usage: Dashed execute-point line for a pending jump. Spec: color.pendingMarker.

styles.name: now
styles.usage: NOW section label in Perform. Spec: type.display.

styles.name: body-perform
styles.usage: MD notes, hints and captions in Perform.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Song title in the header, dialog titles. Spec: type.title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Prepare body text, table cells, menu items. Spec: type.body.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a title. Spec: type.meta.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group labels, set in capitals. Spec: type.label.

styles.name: key-hint
styles.usage: Shortcut letter on a key. The smallest text in the system.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: Song bar and elapsed / remaining in Perform.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Bar in section and the NEXT countdown.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Log lines, timestamps, chart bar, file sizes. Spec: type.mono.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a group label and its keys; between key and value windows.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.usage: Tile padding; between label and value in a row.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Section badges, lane blocks, chips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Keys, fields, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Panels, popovers, dialogs, the Perform frame.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: A key at rest: top highlight, lower edge, soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-key-pressed
tokens.usage: A key while pressed or held; the key also moves down 1 px.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-key
tokens.usage: The yellow Play/GO key at rest.

tokens.name: elevation-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus, with a border. Spec: elevation.popover.

tokens.name: elevation-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, with a border. Spec: elevation.dialog.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area of anything pressable in Perform.

tokens.name: size-key
tokens.usage: Height of Perform keys.

tokens.name: size-key-compact
tokens.usage: Height of Prepare buttons and fields (hit area padded to 44 px on touch screens).

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Setlist rail rows.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Plan strip tiles.

tokens.name: size-status-bar
tokens.usage: Perform status row.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Key press, hover, toggle. Spec: motion.fast.

tokens.name: motion-normal
tokens.usage: Popover and toast in or out. Spec: motion.normal.

tokens.name: motion-hold
tokens.usage: Press-and-hold confirm in Service lock (WF-11).

tokens.name: motion-reduced
tokens.usage: Used instead of motion-fast and motion-normal when the OS asks for reduced motion. Progress that carries time (pending bar, hold fill) still moves. Spec: motion.reduced.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that enters or settles.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Progress that tracks real time: pending bar, hold fill, section progress.
